definitions.short: Berakah , the name of an Israelite, and also of a valley in Palestine
definitions.full: H1294. Berakah II. בְּרָכָה 1. proper name, of a location valley in wilderness by Tekoa 2Chr 20:26 (twice in verse); modern Bereikût compare Be & references 2. proper name, masculine person one of David's band 1Chr 12:3 .

occurrences.englishText: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;
On the fourth day, they assembled themselves in Beracah† “Beracah” means “blessing”. Valley, for there they blessed Yahweh. Therefore the name of that place was called “Beracah Valley” to this day.
